title: Comunicado 2026-06-25
summary: Banxico held the overnight rate at 6.50% by a unanimous 5-0 vote, delivering the pause it had signaled when it closed the easing cycle in May, and guided that it will be appropriate to keep the rate at its current level, judging the stance adequate for the macro environment. Versus the 7 May communique, a divided 3-2 cut that ended the cycle, the message turns from last-cut-with-pause-ahead to a firm, unanimous hold with no easing bias. The hold rests on the observed exchange-rate levels, the absence of demand pressures and the degree of restriction already in place; headline inflation fell to 3.55%, but core is still above 4%, core forecasts were nudged up for Q2-Q4, longer-term expectations stay above target and the balance of risks remains tilted to the upside. Slack and important downside risks to activity are acknowledged but are not used to keep the door to cuts open: a comfortable, data-dependent hold with upside-risk emphasis.

key_quotes.quote: con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por unanimidad mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en 6.50%.
key_quotes.context: Unanimous hold, after the divided 3-2 vote that delivered May's final cut

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno considera que será apropiado mantener la tasa de referencia en su nivel actual.
key_quotes.context: Forward guidance: firm hold at the current level, no easing bias

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Despite the drop in headline, the risk balance stays tilted up (core above 4%, expectations above target)

key_quotes.quote: Se siguen previendo condiciones de holgura a lo largo del horizonte de pronóstico y persisten importantes riesgos a la baja para la actividad económica.
key_quotes.context: Slack and downside activity risks acknowledged, but not enough to keep cuts on the table
